responsibility: Contains the DFA pipeline model for the IBM POWER6 processor. It describes the POWER6 integer, load/store, branch, floating-point, and vector execution resources in more detail than older POWER models, including explicit store-data bypass conditions via rs6000_store_data_bypass_p and latency/bypass rules for FP, vector, direct-move, and divide operations, so GCC can schedule RTL accurately for cpu=power6.
